verdict.rationale: Evidence only documents importing subscriptions *into* Stripe from other providers (Zuora, Recurly, etc.) and migrating customer/payment data *to* Stripe — the reverse direction (exporting subscriptions/invoices/usage and porting stored payment methods to another provider) is never documented. Community evidence even shows a team having to 'write code to move from stripe to recurly/adyen' themselves, implying no built-in export/portability tool exists.
